properties.name: Every export says it is a copy: where and when it was taken, and that it is a fork nobody tracks
properties.statement: Every design export shall carry, in the document itself, that it is an export: the server and design id it was taken from, when, and that from that moment it is a fork reflow2 does not track or refresh. Importing one shall say plainly that it replaces the design it lands in, or starts a new one (rules 3 to 5 of dec:idea-one-blueprint-the-store-is-the-design-and-an-export-is-a-perishable-photocopy). The purpose is that no reader, agent, tool or person mistakes an export for the live design. Two measured cases show the need: fact:a-moved-design-cannot-be-watched-and-its-frozen-export-reads-as-live-2026-09-27, and an export mailed to two people who each import it and both believe they are "on the design" (dec:idea-how-does-somebody-share-a-reflow2-design). Anthony, 2026-09-27, accepting "export stamp", which answers the design-and-export decision's open question (d).
